result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one section header displays a raw localization key instead of translated text, which is the main visible defect.

issues.description: The section header above the popular restaurants list shows the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'), while all other headings render proper text.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the missing translation string for the key 'home_feed.popular_title' in the localization resources, or add a fallback label so the section header displays real copy instead of the raw key.
